newsitem.title: ESTONIA: UHIS BUYS TWO BUILDINGS IN CENTRE.
newsitem.headline: UHIS BUYS TWO BUILDINGS IN CENTRE.

text.p: Uhispank and the Estonian central bank on Monday signed an agreement under which Uhispank bought two buildings in Tallinn centre for a total sum of 74 million kroons, real estate agency Rime said on Wednesday.

Uhispank bought the building of the former logistics house, which used to house a state-owned transport company, and where it was renting office space before for 34 million kroons, Aivar Aigro, director of Rime, told Reuters.
The other building, located in the Old Town and leased by Hoiupank, was bought for 40 million kroons, he added.
The central bank had set the public offer to sell the buildings but only the North-Estonian Bank, recently merged with Uhispank, submitted an offer, Aigro said.
Aigro said the offer complied with the conditions that the former logistics house will get investments worth 30 million kroons and banking activities will continue.
